caption: The drawing depicts a central object resembling an old-fashioned oil lamp or lantern, primarily colored in shades of brown and situated on a matching brown rectangular base with rounded edges. The lamp has a cylindrical reservoir at the top, a small circular handle-like ring attached to its right side, and a winding, curved support connecting the cylinder to the base. Above the lamp, there is a simple, lightly drawn rectangular object with a line and circle inside it, possibly a part or an accessory. In the lower left and lower right corners of the drawing, there are two outlined, uncolored side-views of cylindrical objects with flat tops and bottoms, labeled with scale markings beneath them. The overall composition is enclosed within a faintly drawn rectangular border on a beige or off-white background.
title: Lamp and Tallow Strainer
